post.description: Filters a batch of community IDs down to the ones the given address is a member of. A community is returned only when it is active and the address holds a membership row; listing and privacy are not considered, so a listed community the address never joined is not returned. Communities the address is banned from are never returned. Each entry carries the role the address holds (owner, moderator or member).

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the addresses of the authenticated user's friends. The response has no
profile information: clients resolve the profiles themselves.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Values above the maximum are reduced to it.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip. Values above 100000 are clamped to 100000.

delete.description: Ends the friendship between the authenticated user and `address`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Ethereum address of the other user

403.description: One of the users blocked the other

409.description: The action is not valid for the current friendship status

429.description: Too many friendship or block actions, try again later

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the addresses of the friends the authenticated user and `address` have in
common, without profile information.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Ethereum address of the other user

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Values above the maximum are reduced to it.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip. Values above 100000 are clamped to 100000.

get.summary: Get the friendship status with a user
get.description: Returns the status of the friendship between the authenticated user and `address`.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Ethereum address of the other user

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the pending friendship requests the authenticated user received or sent.
Each request carries the other user's address instead of their profile.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Whether to list the requests the user received or the ones they sent

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Values above the maximum are reduced to it.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip. Values above 100000 are clamped to 100000.

post.description: Sends a friendship request from the authenticated user to `address`.

address.description: Ethereum address of the user to send the request to

message.description: Optional message sent along with the request, limited to 256 Unicode code points

201.description: Friendship request sent, with the receiver's address

400.description: Invalid request or missing authentication: invalid address, a request to yourself or a message longer than 256 characters

403.description: One of the users blocked the other

409.description: The action is not valid for the current friendship status

429.description: Too many friendship or block actions, try again later

patch.summary: Accept, reject or cancel a friendship request
patch.description:
Resolves the pending friendship request between the authenticated user and `address`. There is at
most one pending request per pair of users, so the other user's address identifies it. The receiver
can accept or reject it, and the sender can cancel it.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Ethereum address of the other user

200.description: Friendship request updated, with the other user's address

403.description: One of the users blocked the other

409.description: The action is not valid for the current friendship status

429.description: Too many friendship or block actions, try again later

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of the addresses the authenticated user blocked, with when each one was
blocked. The response has no profile information: clients resolve the profiles themselves.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Values above the maximum are reduced to it.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip. Values above 100000 are clamped to 100000.

200.description: Users blocked by the authenticated user

post.description:
Blocks `address` for the authenticated user. Blocking a friend also ends the friendship. Blocking
an address that is already blocked keeps the original `blockedAt`.

address.description: Ethereum address of the user to block

201.description: User blocked, with the blocked address and when it was blocked

400.description: Invalid request or missing authentication, including an attempt to block yourself

429.description: Too many friendship or block actions, try again later

delete.description: Removes the block the authenticated user placed on `address`. Does nothing if that block does not exist.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Ethereum address of the other user

429.description: Too many friendship or block actions, try again later

get.description: Returns every address the authenticated user blocked and every address that blocked them.

200.description: Blocking status of the authenticated user

get.description: Returns the social settings of the authenticated user, or the defaults when they never changed them.

200.description: Social settings of the authenticated user

patch.description:
Updates the submitted social settings of the authenticated user and returns all of them. At least one
setting must be submitted. The private messages privacy is also synced to Comms Gatekeeper; if that
fails the request answers 500, and a restriction to `only_friends` is not stored.

get.summary: Get the private messages settings of other users
get.description: Returns who can send private messages to each requested user, and whether each one is a friend of the authenticated user.

200.description: Private messages settings of the requested users

post.description:
Calls `calleeAddress`. Fails with 403 when either user only accepts calls from friends and they are not
friends, or one blocked the other, and with 409 when either user is already in, or being invited to,
another private or community voice chat.

403.description: The authenticated user is not allowed to perform this action

409.description: The action conflicts with the current state

On the authenticated user's own address it lowers their hand. On someone else's it rejects their
request, which only owners and moderators can do. Lowering one's own hand is idempotent and
returns 204 even if the room or participant is already gone.
